title: At the Doctor's
audience: Chinese junior students (13-15 years old, average level in mainland China)
imageAlt: A doctor's office: symptom poster, doctor with thermometer, sick boy with ice pack, medicine shelf and advice sign
imageDescription: A bright cartoon doctor's office. On the left wall hangs a big white poster with a red cross and the title WHAT'S THE MATTER? Under the title are four symptom pictures with words: HEADACHE shows a head with a blue ice pack, FEVER shows a red thermometer, COUGH shows a coughing boy, and TOOTHACHE shows a sore tooth. On the right wall, a green sign reads DRINK MORE WATER and TAKE A REST. Below the signs, a wooden shelf holds three medicine boxes labeled FEVER, COUGH and COLD, plus two bottles. In the center, a friendly doctor with glasses, a white coat and a stethoscope holds up a thermometer and smiles. On the right, a sick boy sits on an examination bed: he has a blue ice pack on his head, a red nose, a red scarf, holds a white tissue, and looks tired and sad. A round wall clock shows 10:10, a potted plant stands beside the shelf, and a window shows blue sky with clouds.
scoringDescription: A bright cartoon doctor's office with warm yellow walls. On the left wall, a big white poster with a red cross at the top reads WHAT'S THE MATTER? Below the title, four symptom icons are arranged in two rows, each with a bold word. HEADACHE shows a boy's head with a blue ice pack held on top. FEVER shows a red thermometer. COUGH shows a coughing boy with his hand near his mouth. TOOTHACHE shows a big sore tooth with red pain marks, meaning the person holds his mouth or cheek. On the right wall, a green sign reads DRINK MORE WATER and TAKE A REST. Below it, a wooden shelf holds three medicine boxes with bold labels: a red FEVER box, a green COUGH box and a blue COLD box, plus two unlabeled bottles. Center: a friendly doctor with glasses wears a white coat and a stethoscope around his neck; he holds up a thermometer and smiles at the patient. Right: a sick boy in a yellow sweater sits on an examination bed with a pillow. He wears a red scarf, has a red runny nose, a blue ice pack on his head, and holds a white tissue; his eyes look tired and sad. Evidence for his problem: the ice pack on his head means a headache, the doctor checking the thermometer suggests a fever, and his red nose, scarf and tissue mean he has a cold. He does NOT have a toothache: unlike the poster icon, he does not hold his mouth or cheek. A round wall clock shows 10:10, a potted plant stands next to the shelf, and a window shows a blue sky with white clouds.
